Tara (Docs): Heads-up: updating SOC2 audit-logging doc to cover tenant-facing export behavior + a small YAML sample and SDK snippet. Sharing the rough chat here before PR.

Victor (Security): Make sure the doc distinguishes between "retention policy" (how long we keep persistent records) and "cache TTL" (ephemeral caches). Also flag tenant-scoped KMS handling + rotation implications.

Tara (Docs): Raw YAML example for readability:```yaml
- event: auth.login
  tenant: tenant_555
  time: 2026-03-22T15:23:00Z
  meta:
    ip: 10.0.0.1
  retention_period_days: 90
```

Rina (Legal): For the prose please use "default retention period" and note that contractual terms supersede defaults. Avoid absolute wording unless we have an explicit SLA.

Dev (Eng): Implementation note: public hosted API returns paginated NDJSON for exports. For very large exports we sample older records; we include an export-manifest.json with metadata about sampling, retention window, and whether KMS wrapping is used. In Dedicated deployments sampling is typically disabled by contract.

Tara (Docs): Draft SDK snippet (JS):```js
// pseudo
await client.audit.export({ tenant: 'tenant_555', since: '2026-01-01' })
```

Victor (Security): Please add: "Audit logs are encrypted at rest. For customers who enable customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM), we use envelope encryption and maintain per-tenant wrapped keys. Rotating a KMS key creates a new wrapping key for new blobs; previously wrapped blobs remain accessible unless rewrap is performed."

Rina (Legal): Also include a short sentence about admin access and how export operations are logged. That closes a SOC2 requirement.

deploy-bot: PR draft created by tara/docs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1317 :white_check_mark:

Tara (Docs): I'll open the PR as draft and tag Security + Legal. Thanks all, will push edits now.

Victor (Security): I'll check once PR is up. If we mention 90 days explicitly, add a note that retention is tenant-configurable subject to contract and may require support to change.

Rina (Legal): Will review wording after PR is posted.

Tara (Docs): Great. Thanks :sparkles:
